other_conditions: The benefit is given only on the death of the journalist while working in journalism.
The deceased must have worked full‑time for a newspaper or daily periodical published in Tamil Nadu.
In case of sudden death due to an accident or fatal disease, a minimum of five years of service is required.
Financial assistance amount depends on the total years of service of the deceased (20 years, 15 years, 10 years, or 5 years).
benefits_summary: Financial assistance ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹2,00,000 based on the deceased journalist’s years of service.
documents_required: Relevant certificates and any self‑attested mandatory documents
